findings.finding: Neuroblastoma experiments show PHGDH-independent changes in glucose carbon routing under NCT-503, including knockout cells.
findings.implication: An NCT-503 phenotype is not sufficient evidence that PHGDH alone caused it; orthogonal perturbation and viability controls remain necessary.
